key_objects.name_zh: Strichartz 估计的抛物面限制证明
key_objects.name_en: paraboloid restriction proof of the Strichartz estimate
key_objects.description: Identifies the spacetime Schrödinger extension operator with R* on the paraboloid in R^{d+1}, obtains the compact-frequency estimate (41), and removes the support restriction by parabolic scaling and density.

key_objects.description: Use M={(ξ,ξ_{d+1}): ξ_{d+1}=-2π|ξ|²}; its nonzero Gauss curvature allows Theorem 5.2/Proposition 5.3 to control R*.

key_objects.statement: For I(ξ)=∫_R e^{2πi(ξ1 t+ξ2 t³)}ψ(t)dt with ψ smooth compactly supported, I(ξ)=O(|ξ|^{-1/3}).

key_objects.statement: If F is C∞ and compactly supported on R^d×R, then S(F) is C∞ and satisfies (43) and (44).

key_objects.statement: Estimate (46) holds for q=(2d+4)/d and p=(2d+4)/(d+4), the dual exponent of q.

key_objects.name_zh: S⁺ 与正则化算子 S_ε
key_objects.description: Replace the finite-time Duhamel operator by S+(F)=i∫_{-∞}^t e^{i(t-s)Δ}F(·,s)ds, then regularize it by e^{-ε(t-s)} to obtain S_ε.

key_objects.name_zh: Duhamel 解在 L² 中的逐时刻连续性
key_objects.name_en: L2-valued time continuity of the Duhamel solution
key_objects.statement: For F∈L^p(R^d×R), S(F) can be redefined on a null set so that S(F)(·,t)∈L² for every t and t↦S(F)(·,t) is continuous in L².

key_objects.name_en: mass and energy conservation for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
key_objects.description: The text highlights conservation of ∫|u|² dx and ∫(1/2|∇u|² - σ/(λ+1)|u|^{λ+1})dx over time.

key_objects.name_zh: L² 临界指数 λ=1+4/d
key_objects.description: Scale invariance together with invariance of the L² norm of the initial data forces λ=1+4/d; the exponents also satisfy q=λp.

key_objects.name_zh: 非线性方程的强解
key_objects.name_en: strong solution of the nonlinear dispersion equation
key_objects.description: A strong solution belongs to the relevant spacetime L^q class, solves (54) distributionally, is L²-valued and L²-continuous in time, and attains the initial datum; the same definition is localized to |t|<a.

key_objects.name_zh: 临界非线性 Schrödinger 强解的存在性
key_objects.name_en: existence of strong solutions for the critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation
key_objects.statement: (i) Small L² initial data give a global strong solution. (ii) Arbitrary L² initial data give a strong solution on some finite interval |t|<a.

key_objects.name_zh: 非线性 Schrödinger 的不动点方程
key_objects.name_en: fixed-point equation for the nonlinear Schrödinger problem

key_objects.name_zh: 小数据全局解的压缩映射设置
key_objects.name_en: contraction-mapping setup for the small-data global solution
key_objects.description: On B={u∈L^q: ||u||_q≤δ}, define M(u)=σS(|u|^{λ-1}u)+u0. Theorem 6.7 and q=λp give M(B)⊂B for δ,ε small, while the pointwise Lipschitz bound for |u|^{λ-1}u and Hölder give contraction factor ≤1/2.
